# Provider brand icons

Unmodified SVG assets from @lobehub/icons-static-svg 1.95.1, published by LobeHub under the accompanying MIT license.

Source: https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons/tree/49a2130df7bfa5eb1b088261bff20a37e2967789/packages/static-svg/icons

The provider-to-asset mapping and original SHA-256 hashes are recorded in manifest.json. Google Gemini uses the Gemini brand asset. moonshotai uses the Moonshot AI company asset (not the Kimi product mark). Custom and unknown providers use a separate neutral connection icon.

Brand names and marks belong to their respective owners.
